# Giona Granchelli

> Official portfolio and technical writing by Giona Granchelli, a senior software engineer and chapter lead focused on distributed systems, cloud modernization, JVM engineering, and production AI applications.

This site is the canonical professional profile for Giona Granchelli. It contains work experience, independent projects, technical articles, publications, and links to the software studio Constant Labs and the open-source TramAI project.

- [Professional profile](https://gionag.com/): Career summary, technical focus, skills, education, publications, and contact details.

- [Technical articles](https://gionag.com/articles): Long-form writing about JVM AI, distributed systems, agentic workflows, and cloud modernization.

## Featured Projects

- [Constant Labs](https://gionag.com/projects/constant-labs): Independent software studio building custom AI agents, web applications, and workflow automation.
- [TramAI](https://gionag.com/projects/tramai): Apache-2.0 licensed Java and Kotlin runtime for governed AI applications.
- [IntelliAiBridge](https://gionag.com/projects/intelliaibridge): Secure local proxy plugin for agentic coding through an authenticated IntelliJ Copilot session.
- [WhichDistro](https://gionag.com/projects/whichdistro): Deterministic, schema-driven Linux distribution picker.

## Technical Writing

- [Java for Production AI Agents](https://gionag.com/articles/java-production-ai-agents): Typed outputs, tool integration, governance, observability, and comparisons across TramAI, Spring AI, and LangChain4j.

- [Modernizing Banking](https://gionag.com/articles/modernizing-banking-legacy-to-cloud): A pragmatic path from legacy financial systems to cloud-native infrastructure.
